walls.note: NW party wall: the aimed panorama shows the neighbours Oostenburgergracht 7-13, which stand against this wall to about 12-14 m; above them and along the chapel wing (r430 2017, TMX7316010203-000353_pano_0002_000430) it is plain brick with a downpipe. Left as the 3DBAG shell.

items.where: over every classroom window light: a shallow segmental rowlock arch, the arches of a three-light group meeting on light sandstone springer blocks (register: zandstenen aanzetstukken van de drie licht getoogde ontlastingsbogen)
items.how: relievingArchRow (new kit part src/canalRecall/landmarks/relievingArches.ts): segBand arches on shared pentagonal ochre springers

items.where: three storeys of three-light groups in the wings (and the two upper storeys of the risalit): cream cross windows (kruiskozijnen), four-pane fanlight over six-pane lower lights, 1.54 x 3.27 m at a 1.9 m pitch
items.how: frame, pane and a 4 x 5 paneGrid with the heavy transom over the third row and a heavy mullion

items.where: the high plinth of light grey Bavarian granite to the ground-floor sills (1.84 m), with low basement grilles under the wing windows
items.how: stone slab with dark grille panels

items.where: the middle risalit, barely proud, crowned by a very flat spout gable (17.98 m at the sides to 18.89 m) carrying a cross (register; the cross seen from the water in TMX7316010203-001982_pano_0000_000812)
items.how: brick slab 0.1 m proud, a triangular gable with copper coping and a stone cross

items.where: the two porticoes in the risalit ground floor, framed in granite to 3.46 m, the doors up a few steps, a fanlight over each door under a relieving arch, a low three-light window between them
items.how: granite jambs, pier and lintels 0.3 m proud, dark door leaves in the recess on three stone steps, fanlights with arches; the left portico mirrored about the statue axis (the tree hides it in both views)

items.where: St. Willibrord on a console between the porticoes on the middle axis, about 0.6 x 2.6 m with a pointed canopy, 3.5-6.3 m
items.how: stone console, a lathed robed figure, head, mitre and crozier, a back plate and a four-sided pointed hood

items.where: the two light lettered tableaux between the ground and first floor of the wings, "ST CANISIUS-PATRONAAT" left and "ST VINCENTIUSSCHOOL L.C." right, 3.9 x 0.53 m at 5.96 m
items.how: light panel with one darker strip standing for its line of capitals; the letters are 0.2 m pixel glyphs that would cost ~3,000 triangles each and are unreadable at gallery size

items.where: natural stone sills under the first and second-floor groups
items.how: one grey slab under each group

items.where: the green-grey (copper/zinc patina) coping along the straight parapet of both wings and the gable
items.how: copper slabs on the parapet and along the gable slopes

items.where: two narrow lights either side of the statue under a sandstone lintel band at 5.1-5.5 m
items.how: two 0.42 m windows and an ochre band

items.where: the physiotherapy banner on the left plinth and a beach flag at the door

skip.note: tenant banner and flag, not architecture

walls.note: courtyard wall of the chapel wing facing the neighbours' yards (ring edge 8); the aimed panorama shows Oostenburgergracht 23-25 on the street instead, so no photo of this wall exists. Left as the 3DBAG shell.

items.where: the canted chapel bay on the Wittenburgervaart: a row of five tall white windows (the outer two on the cants) at 5.6-8.3 m, over them two small squares flanking two tall slits at 9.5-11.6 m
items.how: framed windows on edges 13 and 12 with stone sills; the NW cant is not in the BAG ring, so its window stands on the front

items.where: the white coping band round the top of the bay at 12.0-12.3 m
the dark cantilevered hood on three brackets over two basement windows at the quay, 3.6 m
items.how: dark slab 0.62 m deep, bracket wedges, two three-light windows

items.where: grey plinth from the water to about 2.8 m

behind the bay, the 16 m stair and corridor block: rows of small windows on its NE wall, a canted stair tower with one big window per storey, a recessed bay with a balcony and white railing, white copings (seen from the water)
items.how: small windows on edge 2, big windows on edge 5, the balcony and windows on edge 7, white copings on edges 2-7; the 3DBAG shell carries the canted tower

items.where: two grey downpipes down the bay corners

walls.note: short NE face of the stair block (ring edge 7); seen at an angle in TMX7316010203-001982_pano_0000_000812 (2021) with the balcony, modelled under w04-31 n-stair-block
NE end of the corridor block beside the bay (ring edges 9-11): a tall window over a white ledge, seen at 33 m; the ledge and the bay coping are in w04-31; the rest is the 3DBAG shell

note: Identity: gemeentelijk monument 206026, St. Willibrordusschool (P.J. Bekkers 1915 design, built by Jac. Duncker 1919), the only monument record carrying BAG pand 0363100012180539; BAG bouwjaar 1919. The brief's Wikipedia hits (Sarphatistraat, tram 13, the ASM) are about other subjects and are not used. The only street front is the SW Oostenburgergracht facade; the NE end is the chapel bay on the Wittenburgervaart, seen only from the water.
